title: README's command surface section predates the cobra+fang tree
description:
README.md's prose describes the CLI only through 'Development' targets; the operator-facing story (styled help, --version, completion, man pages) that nwj added is nowhere in the README, and the old hand-rolled usage text still exists in cli.go only as the bare-invocation message. A small docs tick could fold the command surface into the README and decide whether the cli.go usage const should be pruned or derived from the tree.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding 46b634a4f894acc04534dd6e9b70b677d68c39f3b66b98e820613ac7dd8c6ce2 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-nwj/attempt-1): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates the done, naming no single item (the fallback names every item at risk in its reason). The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/46b634a4f894acc04534dd6e9b70b677d68c39f3b66b98e820613ac7dd8c6ce2.json on the run branch.
